root_cause.text: The dev-set and key-rotate netlink operations in the PSP driver were missing the CAP_NET_ADMIN capability check, allowing any unprivileged user in the same network namespace to modify shared device state and cryptographic key material.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds the `admin-perm` flag to both operations in the netlink spec and adds `GENL_ADMIN_PERM` to their `flags` in `psp-nl-gen.c`, which enforces CAP_NET_ADMIN. The CVE description explicitly states that these operations "do not require CAP_NET_ADMIN" and only have netns membership verification.

intent_record.intent_summary: Added admin permission requirement to the dev-set operation to enforce access control.
intent_record.what: Added a 'flags' field with value '[admin-perm]' to the 'dev-set' operation definition.
intent_record.how: This change marks the 'dev-set' operation as requiring administrative permissions, restricting its execution to privileged users.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add admin permission requirement to the key-rotate operation.
intent_record.what: Added 'flags: [admin-perm]' line to the key-rotate operation definition in the YAML configuration.
intent_record.how: The key-rotate operation now requires administrative privileges to execute, preventing non-admin users from performing key rotation.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add admin permission check to PSP_CMD_DEV_SET netlink command to restrict configuration operations to privileged users.
intent_record.what: Added GENL_ADMIN_PERM flag to the .flags field of the PSP_CMD_DEV_SET entry in psp_nl_ops, combining it with the existing GENL_CMD_CAP_DO flag via bitwise OR.
intent_record.how: The change requires administrative privileges (CAP_NET_ADMIN) for executing the PSP_CMD_DEV_SET netlink command. Previously, only basic netlink command capability (GENL_CMD_CAP_DO) was required; now unprivileged users are denied access.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add GENL_ADMIN_PERM flag to require administrative privileges for the key rotate netlink command.
intent_record.what: Added GENL_ADMIN_PERM flag to the flags field of a genl_split_ops struct entry, changing it from GENL_CMD_CAP_DO to GENL_ADMIN_PERM | GENL_CMD_CAP_DO.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the netlink subsystem will now require the caller to have administrative capabilities (CAP_NET_ADMIN) in addition to the ability to perform the command, thus restricting the operation to privileged users only.

bic_trace_step.reason: The psp_nl_ops array defines PSP_CMD_DEV_SET without any CAP_NET_ADMIN check. The pre_doit handler is psp_device_get_locked (which only acquires a lock), the flags field only contains GENL_CMD_CAP_DO (indicating a do operation, not a capability check).
